exact_prompt:
Use case: faithfulHD game diffuseUV texture edit, exact original artwork/topology/material.
Reference is ENTIRE ORIGINAL64x64 storedRGB enlarged NEAREST8x to512square only, no artistic modification. Original fullcanvas alpha255 stays separate. Edit the WHOLE original UV square in place. Every normalized position/size/orientation of shaded material fields, black gaps, clipped edges, source shapes and relative dark/light tones stays EXACT. No crop/padding/fitting/recenter/rotate/zoom/atlas arrangement/border, no assembled hat/object, scene or photo.
Keep original muted warm dark-brown plain painted cloth/leather body fields: the broad smooth rounded/tapered main field, its original softly shaded center with ONE existing dark tonal spot at native around24,36 (keep the flat soft dark source tone, do NOT create a new geometric hole/rim/button), original two lighter curved side fragments at left and upper-right, original small lower-right dark rounded patch, and original long upper band/strip. Preserve original broad smooth shading and all black gaps/edge clipping, not new seams/folds. Preserve the SINGLE existing upper-right rectangular dark field with its TWO pale end/side fields, exact source dark center and every subtle flat tone. Its upper edge has EXACTLY FOUR original narrow dark cuts centered at nativeX41,46,51,56 over nativeY1..2, pitch5native; lower edge has EXACTLY FOUR original narrow dark cuts at SAME nativeX41,46,51,56 overY11..12. Keep all EIGHT source cuts and exact count/pitch/phase/width/softness; preserve the original clipped top source row and irregular faint DXT shading without adding/reordering cuts. Attached guide is8x those native coordinates. Do not interpret them as new hardware, letters or teeth. All source-coordinate numbers are constraints only, NEVER text drawn.
Only smooth coarse pixel steps into restrained source-like fine softly painted diffuse material at SAME pattern scale. Plain cloth/leather areas remain plain smooth matte, no new grain rows/weave grid, raised stitches, engraved detail, leather cracks, coarse scratches/mottling/rust/pits/curls, seams/straps/rivets/holes/buttons/extra parts, decorative glowing outlines/glints or stronger source weak highlights. Keep the original soft tonal hierarchy and dark material; numeric brightness handled afterward, never brighten central spot or pale fragments. No invented text, logo, glyph, letters/numbers or ornament. Output ENTIRE original square UV as opaqueRGB only, no labels/comparison.
